mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever wondered if there’s more to you than what meets the eye each day? Beneath all the routines and reactions, there’s a deeper self quietly shaping every thought, every decision—even the way you see the world. Together, we’re about to step into that hidden landscape and explore the fascinating ideas found in The You Beyond You: The Knowledge of the Willing by Ramzi Najjar. This isn’t just another journey through self-help or motivation. It’s an invitation to look beyond the boundaries of what you think you know about yourself. Imagine discovering how unseen forces and old patterns have been quietly steering your life, and what could happen if you started to notice—and question—them. As we dig deeper, you’ll see how awareness and intention can unlock parts of you that have always been there, just waiting for your attention. We’ll talk about the mind’s power, and how it can either open doors or hold us back—sometimes without us even realizing it. Through Ramzi Najjar’s insights, we’ll learn how a little willingness to look inside can spark real transformation. So, what if the path to more freedom and fulfillment is just a matter of waking up to your choices? Let’s explore together, challenge what feels automatic, and see what extraordinary possibilities might be waiting, just beyond the familiar you.
